gaps.sentence: Such ___ the demand for tickets that the website crashed.
gaps.explanation: Such was the demand that… — emphatic result structure.

gaps.sentence: Only when the audit was complete ___ the accounts released.
gaps.explanation: Only when X happened were the accounts released — inversion after only when.

gaps.sentence: Try ___ she might, she couldn't restart the engine.
gaps.explanation: 'Try as somebody might' — fixed concessive inversion.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we started ___ the engine failed.
gaps.explanation: Hardly … when — fixed pair: Hardly had we started when…

gaps.sentence: Little did the suspects ___ that the police were listening.
gaps.explanation: 'Little did they know' — 'know' as bare verb after the inverted auxiliary 'did'.

gaps.sentence: On no account ___ passengers open this door.
gaps.explanation: On no account should passengers… — formal prohibition.

gaps.sentence: Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: So widespread ___ the outage that servers abroad noticed.
gaps.explanation: So widespread was the outage that… — inversion.
